content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling single-family homes to individual buyers, not leasing office space to business tenants."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into residential lots sold to homebuilders; no office leasing or building ownership."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate and government tenants under long-term leases, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder and mortgage lender selling homes to individual buyers, unlike the target's office leasing."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Owns, leases and manages office buildings to corporate tenants under long-term leases, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Owns hotels and resorts selling room nights and event space to travelers, a different business from office leasing."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Owns logistics warehouses leased to distributors and retailers; industrial real estate, not office space."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Self-storage facilities renting units to individuals and small businesses, a different property type and customer base."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates a hotel and apartment complexes with securities investing; no office leasing business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Manages REITs for fees as a service provider rather than owning and leasing office buildings itself."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Florida land developer running resorts, clubs, timber and farmland; residential and hospitality focus, not office leasing."}]}
